name: Chhurpi (hard)
origin: High Himalaya - Ladakh, India; Nepal and Bhutan

fat_pct.quote: * **Fat (% DM = g /100 g dry matter): 7.2 ± 0.32 % DM**

ammonia.reason: Very low water activity arrests proteolysis and amino acid deamination so no NH3 accumulates.

animal_barnyard.reason: Raw yak/dzomo pastoral milk indole and p-cresol from forage concentrated but largely volatilized on sun-drying.

bitter.reason: Acid-heat coagulation without rennet produces no hydrophobic bitter peptides and proteolysis is arrested.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti and no lipolysis-derived methyl ketones in defatted dried curd.

browning.reason: High protein with residual lactose can Maillard if toasted but low fat and glassy matrix limits even browning.

buttery.reason: Defatted buttermilk curd with ~6.5% fat wet and sun-drying loss of diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus citrate metabolism.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Minimal triglyceride substrate and no rennet lipase so almost no butyric/hexanoic free fatty acids.

creaminess.reason: 10% moisture and ~6.5% fat gives no fat emulsion or mouth lubrication, only hard glassy protein.

crumbliness.reason: Dense heat-fused acid curd fractures as hard splinters, not short crumbly rennet curd.

firmness.reason: 10.2% moisture, 92% dry matter protein matrix sun-dried 5-7 days to rock-hard glassy state.

floral_honey.reason: Arrested proteolysis limits phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol.

fruity.reason: Only 0.01% ethanol and low water activity inhibits microbial esterase formation of ethyl esters.

goaty.reason: Cow/yak/dzomo fat not goat fat, poor in caproic/caprylic/capric acids and further defatted by churning.

malty_nutty.reason: Precipitation heating to ~85-90C plus sun-drying drives Maillard/Strecker maltol and pyrazines, limited by low aw.

melt.reason: pH 4.32 calcium-depleted acid network with denatured whey proteins cannot flow, only softens.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No Penicillium/Geotrichum growth and no 1-octen-3-ol pathway in sun-dried low-aw curd.

oil_off.reason: ~6% fat tightly entrapped in denatured protein, no free oil exudation on heating.

smoky.reason: Sun-drying and traditional hearth storage deposits trace guaiacol/phenols, not directly smoked.

sour_vinegar.reason: pH 4.32 with 0.51% titratable acidity, lactic 0.23 mg/g and acetic 0.16 mg/g from LAB concentrated by drying.

stretch.reason: No intact rennet para-casein and no pasta-filata acid kneading, cannot align fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: High-heat denaturation of beta-lactoglobulin releases H2S and cooked-milk sulfides retained in precipitate.

sweet.reason: Residual carbohydrate ~23% DM gives faint lactose sweetness overpowered by lactic/acetic sourness.

umami.reason: 63% DM protein concentrates glutamate but little free glutamate without enzymatic ripening.
